evidence: Package exports expose browser client, server caller, board/query helpers, MCP and Custom Widget configuration surfaces; dependencies are workspace-scoped.
Availability read projects four required columns and uses React request cache for RSC reuse.
HMAC access token derives from the encryption key and binds user, thread and generation; verification compares fixed-length bytes timing-safely.
Telemetry parse allocates arrays proportional to provider response entries; process cache is capped at 512 entries and five-minute TTL.
Parent ordering uses linear maps/sets and explicit stack, preserving input sibling order and handling dangling/cyclic parent references.
Assistant server entrypoint re-exports context/model helpers and telemetry types/token creation only.
RSC board callers and board lookups are React-cached per request.
Browser tRPC React client and imperative fetch client use HTTP and SuperJSON; app router is type-only.
Public API surface re-exports configuration request schema/service and source/session configuration functions.
Environment parser normalizes public HTTP URLs and defines defaults for demo/workshop settings.
Exports app router, caller factory, API context, and inferred input/output types.
Tool extraction traverses registered procedure metadata, builds/validates schemas and sorts tool output per extraction call.
MCP eagerly registers selected routers for synchronous tool extraction; main app router remains lazy.
Docker feature middleware checks environment/demo mode and passes through without adding retained state.
Both one- and many-integration queries retain association rows for auth and now project nested items to boardId only; hasQueryAccessToIntegrationsAsync consumes that field.
Kubernetes feature middleware checks environment flag and passes through without adding retained state.
Claim token is stored as a hash with expiry; claim reads one setting, handles insert races, and does not retain process cache.
Re-exports the single onboarding step normalization function.
Normalization only copies document/components/schema maps if the exact recursive JSON union is found; otherwise returns original document.
OpenAPI generator builds document on invocation and customizes a bounded number of path security/schema/example entries.
Exports bounded query stale/refetch/GC timings and path classifiers/policies for dashboard data and metadata.
Main application router registers feature routers lazily, including assistant, board, app and Custom Widget.
Pagination is used for app management; anonymous app visibility delegates to AppAccessControl, while get/selectable endpoints project task-specific results.
Anonymous access scans every app/bookmark item with full rows and board visibility, then parses options after JS filtering; authenticated access skips it.
Dedicated full-file pass: thread history reads/parses all messages; model and context paths have explicit count bounds; persistence accepts full serialized content.
Dedicated full-file pass: full dashboard query, bounded management previews, layout projections, transaction writes, placement lock lifecycle, and array diff helpers reviewed.
Board permission lookup selects board identity/visibility and only the current user/group permission relations before constructing permissions.
Placement guard compares submitted/stored custom-widget options only when type/config changes; map cost is linear in submitted/stored item counts.
Auth helpers construct a temporary secret map and apply only selected bearer/header/query/basic credentials.
Converts deferred Zod authoring errors to safe BAD_REQUEST tRPC errors.
Cache identity hashes serialized source/request definitions and ordered encrypted secret bindings; sorted secret copy is per call.
Configuration requests use Redis TTL in production and local maps only in CI/test; reads delete expired local entries and lock release is explicit.
Create/update preview paths verify current revision evidence, then persist definition/secrets transactionally through helpers.
Widget binding lookup projects options only, checks board permission when requested, and maps malformed/mismatched bindings to NOT_FOUND.
Router composes feature procedure maps and performs direct CRUD through single-definition queries; feature router is lazy from app root.
Secret input array is encrypted once into transactional rows; definition plus at most supplied secret rows are inserted atomically.
Update locks one definition, reads its secret rows for state fingerprint/binding reconciliation, then updates definition and per-source secret bindings transactionally.
Maps custom-widget domain errors to tRPC errors while exposing only stable transport metadata.
Redacts legacy credential-like URL segments/values before generating migration prompt; parses preserved display config defensively.
Admin list/get/migration and option query paths reviewed; secret relation loads include encrypted values although management mappers consume metadata.
List/get mappers use secret metadata only; available picker maps options/template/request capabilities from validated definition.
Authoring template validation caps joined input at 50k characters; component batches cap at 8 and shared props at 64.
Action path supports simulated mode, explicit confirmation for configured/DELETE actions, scoped concurrency, invalidation, journal and finally release.
Preview creation normalizes/validates definition/options, carries compatible encrypted secrets into session and returns per-request evidence checklist; revision resets evidence.
Evidence validation requires current session revision and successful statuses (simulated actions qualify) before save.
Preview request input bounds request ID and source resolution returns safe configuration errors; journal failures are logged without failing request.
Query path scopes request concurrency, caches by session/request/params/source version, journals response and always releases capacity.
Thin API adapter delegates session, evidence and journal lifecycle to service; production Redis records receive TTLs.
Thin adapter exports domain request/JSON/body limits and delegates bounded execution/cache invalidation.
Redis limiter scripts expire rate/concurrency state; request callers invoke returned release callbacks in finally blocks.
Request values, target and body render delegate to server package validation; no retained request state.
Set/configure/clear paths encrypt credentials and reconcile rows inside transactions; changed auth bindings delete old source secrets.
Secret compatibility is constrained by source origin, network scope, and auth boundary; accepted credential kinds are enumerated.
Admin-only secret operations return kinds/status, never credential values; configuration requests have request/status modes.
Integration source binding resolves an integration and verifies kind/access; no source cache is retained in this API file.
Stored source/request/options strings are SuperJSON parsed and schema validated; failure issue output is capped at ten.
Read/write return both template string and split line array; patch limits edits to 100 and validates optimistic template revision.
Export/import/migration map v2 definitions and preserve only compatible encrypted legacy credentials; admin checks gate all transfer paths.
Workshop search caps results at 20; get/install validate remote widget before installation and secret inputs use shared bounded schema.
Request-scoped React cache shares header/auth context for nested server component calls.
Intersection helper merges two Zod object shapes into a new schema object at router declaration time.
Server settings snapshot is request-cached; underlying query implementation is in DB package.
Server entrypoint creates caller/query-client proxy and React-caches the query client per request.
Bang search reuses request-handler catalog, uses binary search over sorted entries, and returns only matches up to the supplied limit.
Fanout allocates all-settled results and errors proportional to input integration count; warning metadata avoids logging response bodies.
Cookie/header helper reconstructs cookie string on server; QueryClient sets stale time and dehydrates pending queries.
API context stores per-request session/device/base URL and shared DB; auth/onboarding gates are middleware, not global caches.
RSC user settings read explicitly projects preference columns and is request-cached by user ID.
WebSocket entrypoint only re-exports app router type.
Package typecheck includes package source and excludes node_modules; no build outputs are configured here.
